description: This file implements a rate limiter using token bucket algorithm, providing types and methods for controlling event rates, including Limiter, Reservation, and related functions.

classes.name: Limiter
classes.description: Controls event rate using token bucket algorithm, with methods for allowing, reserving, and waiting for tokens.

classes.name: Reservation
classes.description: Represents a reservation for tokens from the Limiter, including delay and cancellation methods.

methods.name: Limit
methods.description: Returns the maximum overall event rate.

methods.name: TokensAt
methods.description: Returns the number of tokens available at a specific time.

methods.name: Tokens
methods.description: Returns the current number of tokens available.

methods.name: Allow
methods.description: Checks if an event can happen immediately.

methods.name: AllowN
methods.description: Checks if n events can happen at a specific time.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves tokens for an event to happen later.

methods.name: ReserveN
methods.description: Reserves n tokens for future events.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks until an event can happen.

methods.name: WaitN
methods.description: Blocks until n events can happen.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a new event rate limit.

methods.name: SetLimitAt
methods.description: Sets a new event rate limit at a specific time.

methods.name: SetBurstAt
methods.description: Sets a new burst size at a specific time.

methods.name: reserveN
methods.description: Helper method to reserve n tokens with maximum wait duration.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Calculates the number of tokens after a time passage.

methods.name: durationFromTokens
methods.description: Converts tokens to duration based on rate.

methods.name: tokensFromDuration
methods.description: Converts duration to number of tokens based on rate.
